name: m5-audit-sched
description: Caller audit of sbt 1.12.15's task scheduler during whole-build `clean; compile` of Pekko 1.7.1: how many tasks are submitted and completed per op, how often the pending queue is rescanned, and how often `ConcurrentRestrictions.update` runs (itable stubs under it were 1.3% of cycles in m5-2x2). The scores are not for timing: the agent's probes slow the fork.
